en.headline: Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival tickets go on public sale today
en.dek: The Tourism Board's four-day waterfront event runs from 29 October to 1 November at the Central Harbourfront, with public booking of tasting passes starting this morning.
body: Public sales of tasting passes for the Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival opened today, following a priority period for American Express cardholders.

The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the festival will run from 29 October to 1 November at the Central Harbourfront Event Space and Tamar Park. Opening hours are 7.30pm to midnight on the first day, 1pm to 1am on Friday and Saturday, and 1pm to midnight on the final Sunday.

The event features more than 340 booths with wines and food from about 31 countries and regions. Online tasting passes that include admission start from HK$258 for eight tokens and a glass. On-site admission is HK$40, with half-price concessions for seniors, children, students and people with disabilities. The organisers said stocks are limited and sold on a first-come, first-served basis.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮門票今日公開發售
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四天海濱美食盛事將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱舉行，品味證今日起公開發售。
body: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮的品味證今日開始公開發售，之前為美國運通持卡人提供優先購票期。
香港旅遊發展局表示，活動將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園舉行。首日晚上7時30分至午夜12時開放，周五及周六下午1時至凌晨1時，最後一天星期日下午1時至午夜12時。
盛事設超過340個攤位，匯聚約31個國家及地區的美酒美食。網上品味證由港幣$258起，包括入場、8張品味券及酒杯。現場入場券港幣$40，長者、小童、學生及殘疾人士可享半價。主辦方指存貨有限，先到先得。
更正：中文版本字元已修正。
